name: Swag
description: A single deep swag, the sector bored out to leave only the drape.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from 210deg at 50% 8%, #000 0 120deg, transparent 0), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 8%, transparent 54%, #000 0); mask: conic-gradient(from 210deg at 50% 8%, #000 0 120deg, transparent 0), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 8%, transparent 54%, #000 0); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
